description: A curated library of 14 practical workflows for planning, personal productivity, learning, health, money, career, relationships, home, travel, entertainment, shopping, hobbies, pets, and digital life.

defaultPrompt: Plan my week around my priorities, energy, commitments, and personal goals.
Create a practical health, food, and fitness plan for my current situation.
Recommend music, films, books, travel, or hobbies that fit my preferences.
interface.longDescription: Argovance Personal & Life brings together 14 focused workflows for personal planning, chief-of-staff support, personal productivity, learning, health, food, fitness, money, investing research, career development, mindset, relationships, family, home, travel, music, entertainment, shopping, hobbies, pets, digital safety and life administration. ChatGPT routes each request to the smallest relevant workflow, separates confirmed information from assumptions, researches current facts when material, and keeps consequential medical, legal, financial, safety and animal-health decisions within appropriate professional boundaries. External actions such as bookings, purchases, messages, playlists, calendar entries, account changes or trades always require explicit authorization and a connected service.
